about: Image cases for the AI scene builder's benchmark. kind: photo | sketch (generated, see tools/gen-images.mjs; `prompt` is what the generator was asked, `description` what the picture really shows) | gt-render (the app's own Wide render of a known scene; `gt` is that scene, `meta` has its cameras and every item's box in metres and in the picture). Paths are relative to ai/bench/. `expect` uses the text-case format of cases/text.json (checked by score.mjs scoreCase); gt-render cases are also scored with score.mjs scoreAgainstGT. `core` marks the 12 ground-truth renders of the quick run.

images.camera: side view at table height; image x = the motion plane's x (left to right)
images.description: Kitchen table, side view. At the left a stack of three hardcover books lying flat (red on top, green, navy at the bottom). A plain wooden plank rests on the top book at its left end and slopes down to the right onto the tabletop. A red ball (about 7 cm) sits on the plank's high left end. Five plain wooden dominoes (no pips) stand upright in an evenly spaced row on the table, starting just right of the plank's low end. Background (counter, plant, utensil jar, cutting board, bowl of lemons) is scenery, not part of the setup.

expect.rubric: Rebuild the setup, not the kitchen: three books, a plank ramp from the top book down to the right, the ball at its top, five dominoes after its foot. The ball should roll down and topple the dominoes.

images.prompt: A wooden plank ramp on a kitchen table, its high left end resting on a stack of three hardcover books; a red rubber ball sits at the top of the ramp; five plain wooden dominoes stand upright in a row on the table just past the low end of the ramp. Shot from the side at table height so the setup reads left to right. Photorealistic photograph, natural soft daylight, sharp focus, realistic scale and materials, no people, no text, no watermark.

images.camera: side view at table height; image x = the motion plane's x (left to right)
images.description: Light wooden table, side view. At the left a wooden gallows stand (flat base, upright post, an arm reaching left from its top); a polished steel ball on a thin dark string hangs from the arm's left end, pulled back to the left by about 40°. Right of the stand's base: seven plain wooden dominoes standing in a row, each taller than the one before (shortest at the left). As drawn, the ball's lowest point is left of the stand's post, so the swing could not reach the dominoes without moving the pendulum closer.

expect.rubric: A pendulum (steel bob on a string or rod) pulled back to the left, and a growing row of seven dominoes to its right (a domino row with growth > 1, or seven dominoes of rising height). The photo's pendulum cannot reach the row; a good answer moves it so the swing does hit the first domino, and says so.

On a light wooden table. Shot from the side at table height so the setup reads left to right. Photorealistic photograph, natural soft daylight, sharp focus, realistic scale and materials, no people, no text, no watermark.
